segments.tts: How fast is AI really moving? Let's measure twelve months.

Researchers at METR track how long a task – in human working time – AI can complete half the time. November 2025: about three hours. This spring: around twelve. That length doubles roughly every three and a half months. That's about ten times longer every year.
And it's getting cheaper. Epoch AI estimates the cost of reaching the same performance falls about thirteen-fold per year.
What does that look like? This autumn alone, AI claimed proofs of famous math problems – and beat eight brain tumor experts in a test.
Ten times longer tasks, thirteen times cheaper – in just one year.
